game.title: Naija Ludo
game.tagline: Roll, race and send them back to the yard!
game.howto.1: Tap the die (or press Space) to roll. A 6 brings a seed out of its yard onto your start square, and earns another roll.
game.howto.2: Tap a glowing seed to move it that many squares, clockwise round the track. With a keyboard press 1 to 4, or the arrow keys and Enter.
game.howto.3: Land on a lone opponent seed and it goes back to its yard, and you roll again. Star squares and start squares are safe.
game.howto.4: Two or more of your seeds on one square make a stack that cannot be captured. You can change this in Rules.
game.howto.5: Three 6s in a row and your turn is lost. The third roll does not count.
game.howto.6: Bring every seed home to the centre to win. You need the exact number to get home. In Quick mode you have 2 seeds and the first one home wins.
rules.title: Rules
rules.note: The computer players follow the same rules as you.
rules.capture.help: Capture a lone opponent seed and roll again.
rules.exact.help: A seed needs the exact number to reach home. Off: any roll that reaches or passes home works.
rules.three.help: Roll a 6 three times in a row and the third roll does not count.
rules.stacks.help.safe: Safe: a stack cannot be captured, and anyone may share the square.
rules.stacks.help.block: Block: a stack is a wall. Nobody else may land on it or jump over it.
rules.stacks.help.off: Off: no protection. Landing captures every opponent seed on the square.
rules.quickFirst: Quick mode: first seed home wins
rules.quickFirst.help: In Quick mode each side has 2 seeds. On: the first seed home wins. Off: both must get home.
rules.autoMove: Move a lone seed for me
rules.autoMove.help: When only one move is possible, make it without asking.
board.label: Ludo board with four yards and a home centre

play.stuckYou: No seed can move. Turn passes.
